name: Google AI Studio
description: Google's free Gemini API tier, covering the Flash family and Gemma 4.
overview: Google AI Studio is the free prototyping console and API for the Gemini model family. The free tier covers the current Flash and Flash-Lite models, Gemini 3 Flash Preview and the Gemini 2.5 models, while the newest Pro models are paid only. Rate limits are set per project and are shown in AI Studio rather than published in the docs.
free_access: Free of charge on the Flash, Flash-Lite and 2.5 model families
Per-project RPM/TPM/RPD shown in AI Studio (roughly 5-30 RPM)
Free-tier prompts may be used to improve Google products
notes: Prompts on the unpaid quota can be reviewed and used to improve Google products outside the EEA, Switzerland and the UK.
